product.title: Kauai Highlights Small Group Tour - A journey to the Canyon & more

description.text: This full-day guided excursion takes you to 8 of Kauai’s gorgeous spots by air-conditioned vehicle, ideal for a shore excursion. Drive through the south and west sides of the island, taking in a mix of scenic views and an opportunity to try and buy local products. Stops include Waimea Canyon, Spouting Horn, Kauai Coffee Company, South Shore Lookouts. Your guide will share the legends and stories of the places you stop by, including the renowned Waimea Canyon, the powerful Spouting Horn, Kauai Coffee Company, and more. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
